summary: A Bondi Junction practice with a 5.0 Google rating is a strength, but booking buttons that only request a callback and pricing silence appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Book a Visit, Book an Appointment and Meet the practice appear to link to the same contact page, which appears to be a callback request ('we'll call you back to confirm a time').
findings.cost: The page says patients can request an appointment online, but they only leave a number, so some will go to a clinic that books instantly.
findings.fix: A real online booking calendar and buttons that match their destination.

findings.problem: All 21 'Read on Google' links appear to point to the same Maps address, and review names appear run together ('Veronicaon Google').
findings.cost: Visitors cannot read the reviews you worked to earn, and the formatting looks careless.

findings.problem: The text 'Your browser does not support the video tag' and 'Don't fill this out if you're human' appear visibly on the page.
findings.cost: Leftover technical text makes the page look unfinished.
findings.fix: Hidden technical fields and a working hero.

findings.problem: The page promises 'clear pricing before any treatment begins' but appears to show no price ranges, and the 2,500+ members figure appears unexplained.
findings.cost: Patients comparing clinics cannot judge value, and unexplained numbers weaken trust.
findings.fix: Treatment price guides and a clear membership explanation.

redesign: Price guides and a membership explainer.
